issue.title: Refuse or warn when a bead closes while a linked-repo commit it relies on is unpushed
issue.description:
Proposed by bob-cli-qj.4 (note #3), triaged by the bob-cli-qj land agent.

## Incident

Phase bob-cli-qj.3 (Bob Prose in Obsidian) closed with a note citing bob-plugins commit
`9426ee8f` as landed and deployed. That commit never reached bob-plugins `origin/master`
and was lost when its workspace clone was re-cloned. Later `bob plugins sync` runs from
master overwrote the dirty deploy. Three later beads (bob-cli-qm.5, bob-cli-qm.6, and
bob-cli-qj.4) each found the Bob Prose work missing, and qj.4 had to re-land it as
bob-plugins `c41e07e9`. The qj.4 host-currency gate is what caught it: all three hosts
lacked the `bob-prose-type-v1` plugin marker.

## Gap

`sase bead close` (and the land-agent flow) never checks that a linked-repo commit a
phase claims to have landed is reachable from that repo's upstream. A phase can close
"done" with work that exists only in an ephemeral workspace clone.

## Desired remediation

When a phase or task bead closes, check every linked-repo checkout the agent opened (or
committed in) during its run. If a checkout has commits not reachable from its upstream
branch, warn or refuse the close and name them. The cited SHA in a close note is a
weaker signal. The repo-open audit trail (`sase repo log`) and the turn's commit
obligations already say which repos the agent touched.

This lives in the SASE tool (`sase bead close`, `/sase_final` repository obligations),
not in bob-cli. A worker must open the sase project with `/sase_repo`.

task_type_fields.proposal: sase bead close, or the land/final flow, should refuse or warn when a linked-repo checkout the closing agent opened or committed in has commits not reachable from its upstream, so a phase can never close "done" on work that exists only in an ephemeral workspace clone.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: It is a SASE tooling change (bead close and final-declaration repository obligations), not part of bob-cli-qj's prose rename. The rename's own lost commit was already re-landed by bob-cli-qj.4 as bob-plugins c41e07e9.

issue.creation_reason: A closed phase cited a bob-plugins commit that never reached origin/master, and three later beads rediscovered and re-landed the missing work. Nothing in the close or land flow checks that cited linked-repo commits are pushed.
